narrative.intro: Idaho Environmental Coalition has $526M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Idaho Environmental Coalition shows 1 award this fiscal year, with an average award size of $526M, and obligations are down 0.9% year over year. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. Obligations by fiscal year show a recent ramp: FY23 was $73.8M, FY24 was $498M, FY25 was $531M, and FY26 is $526M. Earlier fiscal years FY21 and FY22 show $0 in obligations. The single award in the current year drives the high average award size. The note on the page clarifies that figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Use the year-by-year obligation line to track when Idaho Environmental Coalition moved from no recorded obligations in FY21 and FY22 to the multi-hundred-million-dollar levels starting in FY23. This profile focuses on obligations recorded to date in FY2026 and does not include details beyond the presented totals and counts.
